extractions.description: Introduces Manifold Filter-Combine Networks and evaluates several low-pass and wavelet MFCN variants and graph-neural-network baselines on synthetic sphere/ellipsoid point clouds and a melanoma patient dataset; also contributes the Infogain diffusion-scale selection procedure.

type.quote: We then prove that our method is consistent in the sense that it converges to a continuum limit as the number of data points tends to infinity, and we numerically demonstrate its effectiveness on real-world and synthetic data sets.
type.justification: The paper contains proofs and substantial numerical experiments; because it executes and evaluates models and procedures, it is catalogued as empirical.
